{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Concurrent.STM.TVar
import Control.Exception
import Control.Monad (forever, void, when, unless)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Foreign.ForeignPtr
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Foreign.Ptr
import Foreign.Storable
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Simulated tensor buffer for ML inference
data TensorBuffer = TensorBuffer
  { tbPtr      :: !(ForeignPtr Double)
  , tbSize     :: !Int
  , tbRefCount :: !(IORef Int)
  , tbEpoch    :: !Word64
  }

data InferenceRequest = InferenceRequest
  { reqId       :: !Word64
  , reqPayload  :: !(Ptr Double)
  , reqSize     :: !Int
  , reqCallback :: !(Ptr Double -> Int -> IO ())
  }

data ServerState = ServerState
  { ssBufferPool   :: !(TVar (Map.Map Word64 TensorBuffer))
  , ssActiveReqs   :: !(TVar (Map.Map Word64 InferenceRequest))
  , ssEpochCounter :: !(TVar Word64)
  , ssGcLock       :: !(MVar ())
  }

newServerState :: IO ServerState
newServerState = do
  pool <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  reqs <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  epoch <- newTVarIO 0
  gc <- newMVar ()
  return $ ServerState pool reqs epoch gc

allocTensorBuffer :: Int -> Word64 -> IO TensorBuffer
allocTensorBuffer size epoch = do
  fptr <- mallocForeignPtrArray size
  ref <- newIORef 1
  return $ TensorBuffer fptr size ref epoch

retainBuffer :: TensorBuffer -> IO ()
retainBuffer tb = modifyIORef' (tbRefCount tb) (+1)

releaseBuffer :: TensorBuffer -> IO Bool
releaseBuffer tb = do
  modifyIORef' (tbRefCount tb) (subtract 1)
  count <- readIORef (tbRefCount tb)
  when (count <= 0) $ finalizeForeignPtr (tbPtr tb)
  return (count <= 0)

-- The inference pipeline: receives request, allocates output buffer,
-- schedules async computation, then invokes callback with result pointer
scheduleInference :: ServerState -> InferenceRequest -> IO ()
scheduleInference ss req = do
  currentEpoch <- atomically $ readTVar (ssEpochCounter ss)
  outBuf <- allocTensorBuffer (reqSize req) currentEpoch
  
  -- Register buffer in pool
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (ssBufferPool ss) $
    Map.insert (reqId req) outBuf
  
  -- Register active request
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (ssActiveReqs ss) $
    Map.insert (reqId req) req
  
  -- Schedule async inference computation
  void $ forkIO $ do
    -- Simulate model inference latency (variable due to batching)
    threadDelay =<< getInferenceLatency (reqSize req)
    
    -- Retrieve buffer - NOTE: we capture outBuf directly from closure
    -- rather than re-fetching from pool. If GC epoch advanced and
    -- evicted this buffer, the ForeignPtr may have been finalized.
    withForeignPtr (tbPtr outBuf) $ \rawPtr -> do
      -- Write inference results
      mapM_ (\i -> pokeElemOff rawPtr i (fromIntegral i * 0.1)) [0..tbSize outBuf - 1]
      
      -- Invoke the callback with the raw pointer
      -- VULNERABILITY: rawPtr is derived from outBuf which may have been
      -- finalized by the GC sweep if epoch advanced during inference
      (reqCallback req) rawPtr (tbSize outBuf)
    
    -- Cleanup
    atomically $ modifyTVar' (ssActiveReqs ss) $
      Map.delete (reqId req)

getInferenceLatency :: Int -> IO Int
getInferenceLatency size
  | size > 1024 = return 500000  -- 500ms for large tensors
  | otherwise   = return 100000  -- 100ms for small tensors

-- Epoch-based garbage collector for buffer pool
-- Runs periodically to evict stale buffers
gcSweep :: ServerState -> IO ()
gcSweep ss = forever $ do
  threadDelay 200000  -- Run every 200ms
  
  -- Advance epoch
  newEpoch <- atomically $ do
    e <- readTVar (ssEpochCounter ss)
    let e' = e + 1
    writeTVar (ssEpochCounter ss) e'
    return e'
  
  -- Evict buffers from previous epochs
  -- BUG: This evicts buffers that may still be in use by async callbacks
  -- The check against activeReqs is done non-atomically with the eviction
  withMVar (ssGcLock ss) $ \_ -> do
    activeIds <- atomically $ Map.keysSet <$> readTVar (ssActiveReqs ss)
    pool <- atomically $ readTVar (ssBufferPool ss)
    
    let stale = Map.filterWithKey (\k buf ->
          tbEpoch buf < newEpoch - 1) pool
    
    -- Release stale buffers - does NOT check if callback is mid-flight
    mapM_ (\(k, buf) -> do
      freed <- releaseBuffer buf
      when freed $ atomically $ modifyTVar' (ssBufferPool ss) $
        Map.delete k
      ) (Map.toList stale)

-- Reverse proxy health check handler
healthCheck :: ServerState -> IO Bool
healthCheck ss = do
  pool <- atomically $ readTVar (ssBufferPool ss)
  reqs <- atomically $ readTVar (ssActiveReqs ss)
  return $ Map.size pool < 10000 && Map.size reqs < 500

-- Simulated request handler from reverse proxy
handleProxyRequest :: ServerState -> Word64 -> Int -> IO ()
handleProxyRequest ss rid size = do
  inputPtr <- mallocArray size
  mapM_ (\i -> pokeElemOff inputPtr i (1.0 :: Double)) [0..size-1]
  
  resultVar <- newEmptyMVar
  
  let callback outPtr outSize = do
        results <- mapM (peekElemOff outPtr) [0..outSize-1]
        putMVar resultVar results
        free inputPtr
  
  let req = InferenceRequest rid inputPtr size callback
  scheduleInference ss req
  
  -- Wait for result with timeout (proxy has 30s timeout)
  result <- timeout 5000000 (takeMVar resultVar)
  case result of
    Nothing -> free inputPtr  -- Timeout cleanup
    Just _  -> return ()

timeout :: Int -> IO a -> IO (Maybe a)
timeout usec action = do
  resultVar <- newEmptyMVar
  tid <- forkIO $ do
    r <- action
    putMVar resultVar (Just r)
  void $ forkIO $ do
    threadDelay usec
    killThread tid
    tryPutMVar resultVar Nothing
    return ()
  takeMVar resultVar

main :: IO ()
main = do
  ss <- newServerState
  void $ forkIO $ gcSweep ss
  
  -- Simulate incoming requests from reverse proxy
  mapM_ (\i -> do
    void $ forkIO $ handleProxyRequest ss i 2048
    threadDelay 50000  -- 50ms between requests
    ) [1..100]
  
  threadDelay 30000000
